response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT sites.healtheval, AVG(scans.gbsize / NULLIF(scans.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate, AVG(scans.scancount) AS avg_count FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS all_status_avg_rate FROM status_averages) SELECT AVG(s.avg_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(s.avg_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.avg_rate - o.all_status_avg_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_rate > o.all_status_avg_rate;
